```{r}
#### ------------- Quality metrics ------------- ####
qc_metrics_a4 <- read_csv("inputs/quality_metrics/qc_metrics_a4.csv")

#### ------------- Visual ratings ------------- ####
vis_rate_wide_a4 <- read_csv("inputs/vis_QC/A4_visual-QC.csv") |> 
  mutate(session=paste0("ses-",str_pad(session, 3, pad = "0")),
         subject=paste0("sub-",subject)) |> 
  select(-vis_qc_comment) |> 
  filter(vis_qc_criterion %in% c("Coregistration accuracy", "Distortions/dropouts")) |> 
  mutate(vis_qc_criterion= case_when(vis_qc_criterion=="Coregistration accuracy" ~ "vr_coreg",
                                            vis_qc_criterion=="Distortions/dropouts" ~ "vr_dropout")) |> 
  distinct()|> 
  mutate(vis_qc_rating = case_when(vis_qc_rating == 0 ~ "Fail",
                                   vis_qc_rating == 1 ~ "Flag",
                                   vis_qc_rating == 2 ~ "Pass")) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from =vis_qc_criterion, values_from = vis_qc_rating) |> 
  mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)

vis_rate_wide_rosmap <- read_csv("inputs/vis_QC/Rosmap_visual-QC.csv") |> 
  select(-vis_qc_comment, -protocol) |> 
  filter(vis_qc_criterion %in% c("Coregistration accuracy", "Distortions/dropouts", "Spatial normalization accuracy")) |> 
  mutate(vis_qc_criterion= case_when(vis_qc_criterion=="Coregistration accuracy" ~ "vr_coreg",
                                     vis_qc_criterion=="Distortions/dropouts" ~ "vr_dropout",
                                     vis_qc_criterion=="Spatial normalization accuracy" ~ "vr_norm")) |> 
  distinct()|> 
  mutate(vis_qc_rating = case_when(vis_qc_rating == 0 ~ "Fail",

                                   vis_qc_rating == 2 ~ "Pass")) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from =vis_qc_criterion, values_from = vis_qc_rating) |> 
  mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)
```

# Distribution-based thresholds
```{r}


# ------------------- Initialization:

library(robustbase)
library(reticulate)
library(plotly)

py_require(c("scikit-learn", "numpy","scipy"))
GaussianMixture <- import("sklearn.mixture")$GaussianMixture # for gmm
sp <- import("scipy.stats") # for evt

# ------------------- Definition of functions: 

## ---- GMM-related
# extract components and order
extract_components_gmm <- function(gmm) {

  means <- as.numeric(gmm$means_)
  sds <- sqrt(as.numeric(gmm$covariances_))
  weights <- as.numeric(gmm$weights_)
  idx <- order(means)

  list(means = means[idx],
       sds = sds[idx],
       weights = weights[idx])
}


# compute cut-offs
compute_cutoff_gmm <- function(means, sds, weights) {

  if (length(means) < 2) return(numeric(0))

  sapply(seq_len(length(means) - 1), function(i) {

    optimize(function(c) {
      abs(weights[i] * dnorm(c, means[i], sds[i]) -
            weights[i+1] * dnorm(c, means[i+1], sds[i+1]))
    }, interval = c(means[i], means[i+1]))$minimum
  })
}

# ---- GMM based threshold
gmm2_threshold <- function(x) {
  tryCatch({
    x <- na.omit(x)
    x_mat <- matrix(x, ncol = 1)
    gmm <- GaussianMixture(n_components = 2L, random_state = 42L, tol = 1e-5, max_iter = 300L, n_init = 5L, reg_covar = 1e-6)
    gmm$fit(x_mat)
    comp <- extract_components_gmm(gmm)
    cuts <- compute_cutoff_gmm(comp$means, comp$sds, comp$weights)
    list(cutoff = cuts[1],
         means = comp$means,
         sds = comp$sds,
         weights = comp$weights)
  }, error = function(e) list(cutoff = NA, means = c(NA, NA)))
}

# ---- Extreme value based threshold
evt_threshold <- function(x, tail = c("high", "low"),
                          u_quantile = 0.90, alpha = 0.01, min_excess = 20L) {
  tail <- match.arg(tail)
  x <- na.omit(x)
  if (tail == "low")   x <- -x

  u <- quantile(x, u_quantile) # peak over threshold 
  excess <- x[x > u] - u # obs over pot, centered to 0 to make sense of floc=0
  n_exc <- length(excess)
  if (n_exc < min_excess) return(NA)

  tryCatch({
    fit <- sp$genpareto$fit(excess, floc = 0L) # fit generalized pareto distrib
    xi <- fit[[1]]
    sigma <- fit[[3]]
    rate <- n_exc / length(x)
    p <- 1 - alpha / rate

    if (!is.finite(xi) || sigma <= 0 || abs(xi) > 1) return(NA)
    if (p <= 0 || p >= 1) return(NA)

    thr <- if_else(abs(xi) < 1e-8, u - sigma * log(1 - p), u + sigma / xi * ((1 - p)^-xi - 1))

    if (tail == "low") -thr else thr

  }, error = function(e) NA)
}

###########################################################################################################
###########################################################################################################

# ---- Compute thresholds (using previously defined functions)
# higer = worse
compute_thresholds_high_bad <- function(x, percentiles = c(0.90, 0.95), sd_multiplier = c(2, 3), evt_alpha = c(0.01, 0.02)) {
  
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  
  rows <- list()
  
  # percentiles
  for (p in percentiles) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      method = paste0("percentile_", p*100, "th"),
      threshold = as.numeric(quantile(x, p)),
      GMM2_means = list(NA),
      GMM2_sds = list(NA),
      GMM2_weights = list(NA)
    )
  }
  
  # mean + k*sd
  for (k in sd_multiplier) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      method = paste0("mean_", k, "sd"),
      threshold = mean(x) + k * sd(x),
      GMM2_means = list(NA),
      GMM2_sds = list(NA),
      GMM2_weights = list(NA)
    )
  }
  
  # median + k*mad
  for (k in sd_multiplier) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      method = paste0("median_", k, "mad"),
      threshold = median(x) + k * mad(x),
      GMM2_means = list(NA),
      GMM2_sds = list(NA),
      GMM2_weights = list(NA)
    )
  }
  

  # IQR
  q <- quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.75))
  iqr <- q[2] - q[1]
  
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
    method = "IQR_x1.5",
    threshold = q[2] + 1.5 * iqr,
    GMM2_means = list(NA),
    GMM2_sds = list(NA),
    GMM2_weights = list(NA)
  )
  
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
    method = "IQR_x3",
    threshold = q[2] + 3 * iqr,
    GMM2_means = list(NA),
    GMM2_sds = list(NA),
    GMM2_weights = list(NA)
  )
  
  # log IQR
  if (all(x > 0)) {
    lx <- log(x)
    ql <- quantile(lx, c(0.25, 0.75))
    iqrl <- ql[2] - ql[1]
    
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      method = "IQR_x1.5_log",
      threshold = exp(ql[2] + 1.5 * iqrl),
      GMM2_means = list(NA),
      GMM2_sds = list(NA),
      GMM2_weights = list(NA)
    )
    
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      method = "IQR_x3_log",
      threshold = exp(ql[2] + 3 * iqrl),
      GMM2_means = list(NA),
      GMM2_sds = list(NA),
      GMM2_weights = list(NA)
    )
  }
  
  # adjusted boxplot
  adj <- adjboxStats(x)
  
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
    method = "adj_boxplot",
    threshold = adj$fence[2],
    GMM2_means = list(NA),
    GMM2_sds = list(NA),
    GMM2_weights = list(NA)
  )
  
  # evt-based
  for (a in evt_alpha) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      method = paste0("EVT_a", a),
      threshold = evt_threshold(x, tail = "high", alpha = a),
      GMM2_means = list(NA),
      GMM2_sds = list(NA),
      GMM2_weights = list(NA)
    )
  }
  
  # GMM
  gmm2 <- gmm2_threshold(x)
  
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
    method = "GMM2",
    threshold = gmm2$cutoff,
    GMM2_means = list(gmm2$means),
    GMM2_sds = list(gmm2$sds),
    GMM2_weights = list(gmm2$weights)
  )
  
  bind_rows(rows)
}

# lower = worse
compute_thresholds_low_bad <- function(x, percentiles = c(0.10, 0.05), sd_multiplier = c(2, 3), evt_alpha = c(0.01, 0.02)) {
  
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  
  rows <- list()
  
  # percentiles
  for (p in percentiles) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      method = paste0("percentile_", p*100, "th"),
      threshold = as.numeric(quantile(x, p)),
      GMM2_means = list(NA),
      GMM2_sds = list(NA),
      GMM2_weights = list(NA)
    )
  }
  
  # mean - k*sd
  for (k in sd_multiplier) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      method = paste0("mean_", k, "sd"),
      threshold = mean(x) - k * sd(x),
      GMM2_means = list(NA),
      GMM2_sds = list(NA),
      GMM2_weights = list(NA)
    )
  }
  
  # median - k*mad
  for (k in sd_multiplier) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      method = paste0("median_", k, "mad"),
      threshold = median(x) - k * mad(x),
      GMM2_means = list(NA),
      GMM2_sds = list(NA),
      GMM2_weights = list(NA)
    )
  }
  

  # IQR
  q <- quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.75))
  iqr <- q[2] - q[1]
  
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
    method = "IQR_x1.5",
    threshold = q[1] - 1.5 * iqr,
    GMM2_means = list(NA),
    GMM2_sds = list(NA),
    GMM2_weights = list(NA)
  )
  
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
    method = "IQR_x3",
    threshold = q[1] - 3 * iqr,
    GMM2_means = list(NA),
    GMM2_sds = list(NA),
    GMM2_weights = list(NA)
  )
  
  # log IQR
  if (all(x > 0)) {
    lx <- log(x)
    ql <- quantile(lx, c(0.25, 0.75))
    iqrl <- ql[2] - ql[1]
    
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      method = "IQR_x1.5_log",
      threshold = exp(ql[1] - 1.5 * iqrl),
      GMM2_means = list(NA),
      GMM2_sds = list(NA),
      GMM2_weights = list(NA)
    )
    
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      method = "IQR_x3_log",
      threshold = exp(ql[1] - 3 * iqrl),
      GMM2_means = list(NA),
      GMM2_sds = list(NA),
      GMM2_weights = list(NA)
    )
  }
  
  # adjusted boxplot

  adj <- adjboxStats(x)
  
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
    method = "adj_boxplot",
    threshold = adj$fence[1],
    GMM2_means = list(NA),
    GMM2_sds = list(NA),
    GMM2_weights = list(NA)
  )
  
  # evt-based
  for (a in evt_alpha) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      method = paste0("EVT_a", a),
      threshold = evt_threshold(x, tail = "low", alpha = a),
      GMM2_means = list(NA),
      GMM2_sds = list(NA),
      GMM2_weights = list(NA)
    )
  }
  
  # GMM
  gmm2 <- gmm2_threshold(x)
  
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
    method = "GMM2",
    threshold = gmm2$cutoff,
    GMM2_means = list(gmm2$means),
    GMM2_sds = list(gmm2$sds),
    GMM2_weights = list(gmm2$weights)
  )
  
  bind_rows(rows)
}

###########################################################################################################

# ---- Create interactive plot
plot_thresholds_interactive <- function(dataset,
                                        metric,
                                        id_var = "code",
                                        df_thresholds,
                                        direction = c("low", "high"),
                                        nbins = 80,
                                        metric_name = metric) {

  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  # Prepare dataframes
  df <- dataset |>
    select(x = all_of(metric), id = all_of(id_var)) |>
    filter(!is.na(x))

  thr_valid <- df_thresholds |>
    filter(!is.na(threshold))

  # Create metric's histogram and retrieve relevant values
  
  # h <- hist(df$x, breaks = nbins, plot = FALSE)
  # 
  # global_breaks <- h$breaks
  # global_mids <- h$mids
  # global_counts <- h$counts
  # global_widths <- diff(global_breaks)
  # max_global <- max(global_counts)
  g <- df |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = x)) + 
    geom_histogram(bins = nbins)
  b <- ggplot_build(g)$data[[1]]

  global_breaks <- c(b$xmin, tail(b$xmax, 1))
  global_mids <- b$x
  global_counts <- b$count
  global_widths <- diff(global_breaks)
  max_global <- max(global_counts)

  # define color scale
  method_colors <- paletteer::paletteer_d("Polychrome::light", n = nrow(thr_valid)) |> as.character()

  # --- is this row a GMM method with valid parameters?
  is_gmm_valid <- function(i) {
    grepl("GMM", thr_valid$method[i]) &&
      !is.null(thr_valid$GMM2_means[[i]])  &&
      !any(is.na(thr_valid$GMM2_means[[i]])) &&
      !any(is.na(thr_valid$GMM2_sds[[i]]))  &&
      !any(is.na(thr_valid$GMM2_weights[[i]]))
  }

  # Compute number of traces per method since they're different (3 standard + 2 density curves for GMM)
  n_traces_per_method <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(thr_valid)), function(i) {
    if (is_gmm_valid(i)) 5L else 3L
  })

  # base traces: 1 global histogram + 1 segment per threshold
  n_base <- 2 + nrow(thr_valid)
  n_thr <- sum(n_traces_per_method)
  n_total <- n_base + n_thr

  # start trace index for each method
  trace_starts <- n_base + c(0, cumsum(head(n_traces_per_method, -1))) + 1

  # ---- Base figure
  fig <- plot_ly()

  # ---- All thresholds view
  fig <- fig |>
    add_bars(x = global_mids,
             y = global_counts,
             width = global_widths,
             marker = list(color = "black", line = list(color = "white", width = 0.5)),
             opacity = 0.7,
             name = paste0("Distribution (n=", nrow(df), ")"),
             hovertemplate = "avg=%{x:.3f}<br>(n=%{y})<extra></extra>") |>
    add_trace(x = df$x,
            y = rep(-max_global * 0.02, nrow(df)),
            type = "scatter",
            mode = "markers",
            marker = list(symbol = "line-ns-open",
                          size = 8,
                          color = "#00688b",
                          opacity = 0.5),
            name = "Data rug",
            hoverinfo = "skip")

  # for (i in seq_len(nrow(thr_valid))) {
  #   fig <- fig |>
  #     add_segments(x = thr_valid$threshold[i],
  #                  xend = thr_valid$threshold[i],
  #                  y = 0,
  #                  yend = max_global * 1.05,
  #                  line = list(color = method_colors[i], width = 1.5, dash = "solid"),
  #                  name = thr_valid$method[i],
  #                  hovertemplate = "cutoff=%{x:.3f}")
  # }
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(thr_valid))) {
    y_seq <- seq(0, max_global * 1.05, length.out = 20)
    
    fig <- fig |>
      add_trace(x = rep(thr_valid$threshold[i], length(y_seq)),
                y = y_seq,
                type = "scatter",
                mode = "lines",
                line = list(color = method_colors[i], width = 1.5, dash = "solid"),
                name = thr_valid$method[i],
                hovertemplate = paste0(thr_valid$method[i], ": cutoff=%{x:.3f}<extra></extra>"))
  }
  
  # Visibility vector for "All thresholds" view
  visibility <- list(c(rep(TRUE, n_base), rep(FALSE, n_thr)))

  # ---- Threshold-specific views
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(thr_valid))) {

    thr <- thr_valid$threshold[i]
    flagged <- if (direction == "low") df$x < thr else df$x > thr

    ok <- df$x[!flagged]
    bad <- df$x[flagged]

    n_flag <- sum(flagged)
    pct_flag <- round(100 * n_flag / nrow(df), 1)

    local_breaks <- sort(unique(c(global_breaks, thr)))
    local_mids <- head(local_breaks, -1) + diff(local_breaks) / 2
    local_w <- diff(local_breaks)

    h_ok <- hist(ok,  breaks = local_breaks, plot = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)
    h_bad <- hist(bad, breaks = local_breaks, plot = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)

    local_max <- max(h_ok$counts + h_bad$counts)

    # Build codes of flagged obs per bin
    bin_ids_bad <- vector("list", length(local_breaks) - 1)
    for (b in seq_along(bin_ids_bad)) {
      in_bin <- if (b == length(bin_ids_bad)) {
        df$x >= local_breaks[b] & df$x <= local_breaks[b + 1]
      } else {
        df$x >= local_breaks[b] & df$x < local_breaks[b + 1]
      }
      bin_ids_bad[[b]] <- paste(df$id[in_bin & flagged], collapse = "<br>")
    }
    code4bad <- unlist(bin_ids_bad)

    # Add okk/flag bars + threshold segment
    y_seq <- seq(0, local_max * 1.05, length.out = 20)

    fig <- fig |>
      add_bars(x = local_mids,
               y = h_ok$counts,
               width = local_w,
               marker = list(color = "#00cc66", line = list(color = "white", width = 0.5)),
               opacity = 0.8,
               name = paste0("Ok (n=", length(ok), ")"),
               hovertemplate = "avg=%{x:.3f}<br>(n=%{y})<extra></extra>",
               visible = FALSE) |>
      add_bars(x = local_mids,
               y = h_bad$counts,
               width = local_w,
               customdata = code4bad,
               marker = list(color = "#e13102", line = list(color = "white", width = 0.5)),
               opacity = 0.8,
               name = paste0("Flags (n=", n_flag, ", ", pct_flag, "%)"),
               hovertemplate = "avg=%{x:.3f} (n=%{y})<br>%{customdata}<extra></extra>",
               visible = FALSE) |>
      add_trace(x = rep(thr, length(y_seq)),
                y = y_seq,
                type = "scatter",
                mode = "lines",
                line = list(color = method_colors[i], width = 2, dash = "dash"),
                name = thr_valid$method[i],
                hovertemplate = "cutoff=%{x:.3f}<extra></extra>",
                visible = FALSE)
  

    # Add GMM density curves if applicable
    if (is_gmm_valid(i)) {

      means <- thr_valid$GMM2_means[[i]]
      sds <- thr_valid$GMM2_sds[[i]]
      weights <- thr_valid$GMM2_weights[[i]]

      x_seq <- seq(min(df$x), max(df$x), length.out = 300)
      bin_width <- mean(diff(local_breaks))
      scaler <- nrow(df) * bin_width  # scale density to count space
      
      gmm_line_colors <- if (direction == "low") {
        c("#a80000", "#107c10")
      } else {
        c("#107c10", "#a80000")
      }      
      
      gmm_colors <- if (direction == "low") {
        c("rgba(168, 0, 0,0.25)", "rgba(16, 124, 16,0.25)")
      } else {
        c("rgba(16,124,16,0.25)", "rgba(168, 0, 0,0.25)")
      }
      
      for (k in 1:2) {
        dens <- weights[k] * dnorm(x_seq, mean = means[k], sd = sds[k]) * scaler
        fig <- fig |>
          add_trace(x = x_seq,
                    y = dens,
                    type = "scatter",
                    mode = "lines",
                    fill = "tozeroy",
                    fillcolor = gmm_colors[k],
                    line = list(color = gmm_line_colors[k],
                                width = 2,
                                dash = "solid"),
                    name = paste0("GMM comp.", k,
                                  " (μ=", round(means[k], 3),
                                  ", σ=", round(sds[k], 3), ")"),
                    hoverinfo = "skip",
                    visible = FALSE)
      }
    }

    # Build visibility vector for this method
    # vis <- rep(FALSE, n_total)
    # start <- trace_starts[i]
    # vis[start:(start + n_traces_per_method[i] - 1)] <- TRUE
    # visibility[[i + 1]] <- vis
    vis <- rep(FALSE, n_total)
    vis[2] <- TRUE
    start <- trace_starts[i]
    vis[start:(start + n_traces_per_method[i] - 1)] <- TRUE
    visibility[[i + 1]] <- vis
  }

  # ---- Dropdown menu
  labels <- c("All thresholds", sapply(seq_len(nrow(thr_valid)), function(i) {
    thr <- thr_valid$threshold[i]
    flagged <- if (direction == "low") df$x < thr else df$x > thr
    pct <- round(100 * mean(flagged), 1)
    paste0(thr_valid$method[i], " (", pct, "% flagged)")
  }))

  buttons <- lapply(seq_along(labels), function(i) {
    list(method = "update",
         args= list(list(visible = visibility[[i]])),
         label = labels[i])
  })

  # ---- Layout
  fig <- fig |>
    layout(title = list(text = paste0(metric_name, ": QC threshold explorer")),
           barmode = "stack",  plot_bgcolor = "white", paper_bgcolor = "white",
           xaxis  = list(title = metric_name, gridcolor = "#e5e5e5"), yaxis = list(title = "Count",gridcolor = "#e5e5e5"),
           legend = list(orientation = "v", x = 1.02, y = 1, xanchor = "left"),
           updatemenus = list(list(type = "dropdown",
                                   buttons = buttons,
                                   x = 0,y = 1.15)))

  fig
}

###########################################################################################################
###########################################################################################################

# --- Create function to run the main pipeline, preventing copy paste each time
explore_thresholds <- function(dataset,
                               metrics,
                               id_var = "code",
                               direction = c("low", "high"),
                               metric_names = NULL,
                               exclude_methods = NULL,
                               nbins = 80,
                               save_dir = NULL,
                               file_names= NULL) {

  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  if (is.null(metric_names)) metric_names <- metrics
  if (!is.null(save_dir)) {
    if (is.null(file_names)) file_names <- paste0(metrics, ".html")
    dir.create(save_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  compute_fn <- if (direction == "low") compute_thresholds_low_bad else compute_thresholds_high_bad

  plots <- lapply(seq_along(metrics), function(i) {

    metric <- metrics[i]
    mname <- metric_names[i]
    x <- dataset[[metric]]
    n <- sum(!is.na(x))

    thr <- suppressWarnings(compute_fn(x)) |>
      mutate(flags_n = sapply(threshold, function(t) {
        if (direction == "low") sum(x < t, na.rm = TRUE) else sum(x > t, na.rm = TRUE)
        }),
        flags_pct = round(100 * flags_n / n, 1))

    if (!is.null(exclude_methods))
      thr <- thr |> filter(!grepl(paste(exclude_methods, collapse = "|"), method))

    p <- plot_thresholds_interactive(dataset = dataset,
                                     metric = metric,
                                     id_var = id_var,
                                     df_thresholds = thr,
                                     direction = direction,
                                     nbins=nbins,
                                     metric_name= mname)

    if (!is.null(save_dir))
      htmlwidgets::saveWidget(p, file.path(save_dir, file_names[i]))

    p
  })

  names(plots) <- metrics
  invisible(plots)
}
```

## Get average threshold
```{r}


# -- Define functions:
# ----- Compute average threshold
get_avg_threshold <- function(df, metrics, direction) {
  if (direction == "low") {
    thresh_fn <- compute_thresholds_low_bad
  } else if (direction == "high") {
    thresh_fn <- compute_thresholds_high_bad
  } else {
    stop("direction must be low or high")
  }
  
  purrr::map_dfr(metrics, function(metric) {
    df[[metric]] |>
      thresh_fn() |>
      filter(!grepl("percentile", method)) |>
      summarise(avg_thresh = mean(threshold)) |>
      mutate(metric = metric, direction = direction, .before = 1)
  })
}

# ----- Plot
plot_hist_thres <- function(df_data, metrics, bins = 40, df_thr) {
  purrr::map(metrics, function(var) {
    df_data |>
      ggplot(aes(x = .data[[var]])) +
      geom_histogram(color = "white", bins = bins, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_rug(alpha = 0.8, color = "deepskyblue4") +
      geom_vline(data = df_thr |> filter(metric== var), aes(xintercept = avg_thresh), linetype=1, linewidth=0.5, color="red2") +
      geom_label(data = df_thr |> filter(metric == var), mapping = aes(x = avg_thresh, label = round(avg_thresh, 3), color = "red2"),
        y = Inf, vjust = 2, hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE,
        label.size = NA, fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.6)) +
      # geom_text(data = df_thr |> filter(metric == var), mapping = aes(x = avg_thresh, label = paste0("avg = ",round(avg_thresh, 3)), color ="red2"),
      #           y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, size=3.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
      theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey30"), strip.text= element_text(colour = "white")) +
      labs(x = var)
  })
}
```

```{r}
# -- Boxplot with par category 
# 2 categories 
p_boxplot_2 <- function(data, mapping, site_var = NULL, ...) {
  
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  d <- data |> 
    filter(!is.na(.data[[x_name]]))
  
  # add stats
  predictors <- c(x_name, "age")
  if (!is.null(site_var)) predictors <- c(predictors, site_var)
  m_formula <- as.formula(paste(y_name,"~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "), "+ (1|subject)"))

  m<- lmerTest::lmer(m_formula, data = d)
  emm_formula <- as.formula(paste("pairwise ~", x_name))
  temp <- emmeans::emmeans(m, emm_formula)$contrast |> as.data.frame()
  t_val <- round(temp[, "t.ratio"], 2)
  t_p <- format_pval_star(temp[, "p.value"])

  label_txt <- paste0("t = ", t_val, t_p)
  
  y_max <- max(d[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(d[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  seg_y  <- y_max + 0.08 * y_range
  text_y <- y_max + 0.14 * y_range
  
  d |> ggplot(aes(x = .data[[x_name]], y = .data[[y_name]], color = .data[[x_name]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
    paletteer::scale_color_paletteer_d("nbapalettes::sixers_retro") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
    annotate("segment", x=1, xend=2, y=seg_y, yend=seg_y, linewidth=0.3) +
    annotate("text", x=1.5, y=text_y, label = label_txt, size=2, vjust= 0) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20)))
}

# 3 categories 
p_boxplot_3 <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  d <- data |> 
    filter(!is.na(.data[[x_name]]))
  
  # add stats
  predictors <- c(x_name, "age", "sex")
  m_formula <- as.formula(paste(y_name,"~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "), "+ (1|subject)"))

  m<- lmerTest::lmer(m_formula, data = d)
  emm_formula <- as.formula(paste("pairwise ~", x_name))
  temp <- emmeans::emmeans(m, emm_formula)$contrast |> as.data.frame()
  contrasts_split <- strsplit(temp$contrast, " - ")

  temp$x1 <- sapply(contrasts_split, `[`, 1)
  temp$x2 <- sapply(contrasts_split, `[`, 2)
  lvls <- levels(factor(d[[x_name]]))
  temp$xstart <- match(temp$x1, lvls)
  temp$xend <- match(temp$x2, lvls)

  temp$label <- paste0("t = ", round(temp$t.ratio, 2),format_pval_star(temp$p.value))

  y_max <- max(d[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(d[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min

  temp$seg_y <- y_max + seq_len(nrow(temp)) * 0.7 * y_range
  temp$text_y <- temp$seg_y + 0.1 * y_range
  
  d |> ggplot(aes(x = .data[[x_name]], y = .data[[y_name]], color = .data[[x_name]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
    paletteer::scale_color_paletteer_d("ltc::trio1") +
    geom_segment(data=temp, aes(x=xstart, xend=xend, y=seg_y, yend = seg_y), linewidth=0.3, inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    geom_text(data=temp, aes(x=(xstart+xend)/2, y=text_y, label=label), size = 2, inherit.aes=FALSE, vjust=0) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}

  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)

  data |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[x_name]]), !is.na(.data[[y_name]])) |> 
    count(.data[[x_name]], .data[[y_name]]) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[x_name]], y = .data[[y_name]], color = .data[[x_name]])) +
    geom_point(aes(size = n), shape = 15, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "D",
                         end = 0.8, begin = 0.2) +
    geom_label(aes(label = paste0("n = ",n), fill= .data[[y_name]]), size=2, label.size=0, color="white") +
    paletteer::scale_fill_paletteer_d("ltc::trio1") +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 10) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}

# Format p-values
format_pval <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001***",
                   p < 0.01 ~ paste0("p = ", round(p, 3), "**"),
                   p < 0.05 ~ paste0("p = ", round(p, 3), "*"),
                   TRUE ~ paste0("p = ", round(p, 3)))
}

format_pval_star <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "***",
                   p < 0.01 ~ "**",
                   p < 0.05 ~ "*",
                   TRUE ~ "")
}

# -- Correlation coef
p_cor_text <- function(data, mapping, method = c("pearson", "kendall", "spearman"), ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  corr <- cor.test(data[[x_name]], data[[y_name]], use = "complete.obs", method = method)
  r <- round(corr$estimate, 2)
  sym <- if (method == "kendall") "τ" else "r"

  p_lab <- format_pval(corr$p.value)
  method_lab <- case_when(method=="pearson" ~ "Pearson",
                          method=="kendall" ~ "Kendall",
                          method=="spearman" ~ "Spearman")

  ggplot(data, mapping) +
    geom_blank() +
    annotate("text",x= mean(range(data[[x_name]], na.rm = TRUE)),
             y= mean(range(data[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)),
             label = paste0(method_lab, ":\n",sym, " = ", r, "\n", p_lab),
             size = 2.5,
             colour = "#fd6a00") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.text  = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank())
}

## pearson or kendall
p_cor_p <- function(data, mapping, ...) p_cor_text(data, mapping, method = "pearson",  ...)
p_cor_s <- function(data, mapping, ...) p_cor_text(data, mapping, method = "spearman",  ...)
p_cor_t <- function(data, mapping, ...) p_cor_text(data, mapping, method = "kendall", ...)


# -- Logistic glm (x= metric, y= vr)
p_logist_text <- function(data, mapping, site_var = NULL, ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x) 
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)
  
  df <- data |> filter(!is.na(.data[[x_name]]))

  # kendall τ between metric and visual ratings
  y_num <- as.numeric(df[[x_name]])
  kt <- cor.test(df[[y_name]], y_num, use = "complete.obs", method = "kendall")

  tau <- round(kt$estimate, 2)
  tau_p <- format_pval_star(kt$p.value)

  # glm
  df_glm <- df |>
    mutate(.fail = case_when(.data[[x_name]] == "Pass" ~ 1L,
                             .data[[x_name]] %in% c("Flag", "Fail") ~ 0L)) |>
    filter(!is.na(.fail))

  predictors <- c(y_name, "vis_qc_rater")
  if (!is.null(site_var)) predictors <- c(predictors, site_var)
  m_formula <- as.formula(paste(".fail ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))

  m<- glm(m_formula, family = "binomial", data = df_glm)
  stat_term <- summary(m)$coefficients[y_name, , drop = FALSE]
  z_val <- round(stat_term[, "z value"], 2)
  z_p <- format_pval_star(stat_term[, "Pr(>|z|)"])

  # Prepare text for plot
  label_txt <- paste0("Kendall:\n τ =", tau, tau_p, "\nGLM:\nZ = ", z_val, z_p)

  data |> 
    # filter(!is.na(.data[[y_name]])) |> 
    ggplot(mapping) +
    geom_blank() +
    annotate("text", 
             x= 0.5,
             y = 0.5,
             label = label_txt,
             size = 2.5,
             colour = "deepskyblue4") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1))
}

p_lmer_num_text <- function(data, mapping, site_var = NULL, ...) {

  # Prepare text for plot

  ggplot(data, mapping) +
    geom_blank() +
    annotate("text", 
             x= mean(range(data[[x_name]], na.rm = TRUE)),
             y = mean(range(data[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)),

    theme(axis.text  = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank())

# -- Make router

metric_vars <- c("fd", "dice_coreg", "nmi_coreg", "dropout_score", "nmi_norm")
num_vars <- c("age")
sex <- "sex"
site <- "scanner_manufacturer"
vr_vars  <- c("vr_coreg", "vr_dropout")


make_router_lower <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  x_metric <- x_name %in% metric_vars
  x_num <- x_name %in% num_vars
  x_sex <- x_name == sex
  x_site <- x_name == site
  x_vr <- x_name %in% vr_vars
  y_metric <- y_name %in% metric_vars
  y_num <- y_name %in% num_vars
  y_sex <- y_name == sex
  y_site <- y_name == site
  y_vr <- y_name %in% vr_vars

  if (x_metric && y_metric) p_scatter_metric(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_metric && y_num) p_scatter_age(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_metric && y_sex) p_hist_num_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_num && y_sex) p_hist_num_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_num && y_site) p_hist_num_3(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_metric && y_site) p_hist_num_3(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_metric && y_vr) p_boxplot_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_num && y_vr) p_violin_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_vr && y_vr) p_colbar_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (y_site && x_sex) p_colbar_3(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_site && y_vr) p_colbar_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_sex && y_vr) p_colbar_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else ggally_blank()
}

make_router_upper <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  x_metric <- x_name %in% metric_vars
  x_num <- x_name %in% num_vars
  x_sex <- x_name == sex
  x_site <- x_name == site
  x_vr <- x_name %in% vr_vars
  y_metric <- y_name %in% metric_vars
  y_num <- y_name %in% num_vars
  y_sex <- y_name == sex
  y_site <- y_name == site
  y_vr <- y_name %in% vr_vars

  if (x_metric && y_metric)  p_cor_p(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_num && y_metric)  p_lmer_num_text(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_sex && y_metric) p_boxplot_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_sex && y_num) p_boxplot_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_site && y_metric) p_boxplot_3(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_site && y_num) p_boxplot_3(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (y_metric && x_vr) p_logist_text_site(data, mapping)  
  else if (y_site && x_vr) p_square_3(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (y_sex && x_vr) p_square_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (y_vr && x_vr) p_square(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_site && y_sex) p_colbar_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (y_num && x_vr) p_jitter_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else ggally_blank()
}


make_diag <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  nm <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  if (nm %in% num_vars) p_hist_num_1(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (nm %in% metric_vars) p_hist_num_1(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (nm == sex) p_bar_count_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (nm == site) p_bar_count_3(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (nm %in% vr_vars) p_bar_count_vr(data, mapping, ...)
}
```

```{r}
# -- Boxplot with par category 
# 2 categories 
p_boxplot_2 <- function(data, mapping, site_var = NULL, ...) {
  
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  d <- data |> 
    filter(!is.na(.data[[x_name]]))
  
  # add stats
  predictors <- c(x_name, "age")
  if (!is.null(site_var)) predictors <- c(predictors, site_var)
  m_formula <- as.formula(paste(y_name,"~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "), "+ (1|subject)"))

  m<- lmerTest::lmer(m_formula, data = d)
  emm_formula <- as.formula(paste("pairwise ~", x_name))
  temp <- emmeans::emmeans(m, emm_formula)$contrast |> as.data.frame()
  t_val <- round(temp[, "t.ratio"], 2)
  t_p <- format_pval_star(temp[, "p.value"])

  label_txt <- paste0("t = ", t_val, t_p)
  
  y_max <- max(d[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(d[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  seg_y  <- y_max + 0.08 * y_range
  text_y <- y_max + 0.14 * y_range
  
  d |> ggplot(aes(x = .data[[x_name]], y = .data[[y_name]], color = .data[[x_name]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
    paletteer::scale_color_paletteer_d("nbapalettes::sixers_retro") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
    annotate("segment", x=1, xend=2, y=seg_y, yend=seg_y, linewidth=0.3) +
    annotate("text", x=1.5, y=text_y, label = label_txt, size=2, vjust= 0) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20)))
}

# 3 categories 
p_boxplot_3 <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  d <- data |> 
    filter(!is.na(.data[[x_name]]))
  
  # add stats
  predictors <- c(x_name, "age", "sex")
  m_formula <- as.formula(paste(y_name,"~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "), "+ (1|subject)"))

  m<- lmerTest::lmer(m_formula, data = d)
  emm_formula <- as.formula(paste("pairwise ~", x_name))
  temp <- emmeans::emmeans(m, emm_formula)$contrasts |> as.data.frame()
  contrasts_split <- strsplit(temp$contrast, " - ")

  temp$x1 <- sapply(contrasts_split, `[`, 1)
  temp$x2 <- sapply(contrasts_split, `[`, 2)
  lvls <- levels(factor(d[[x_name]]))
  temp$xstart <- match(temp$x1, lvls)
  temp$xend <- match(temp$x2, lvls)

  temp$label <- paste0("t = ", round(temp$t.ratio, 2),format_pval_star(temp$p.value))

  y_max <- max(d[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(d[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min

  temp$seg_y <- y_max + seq_len(nrow(temp)) * 0.7 * y_range
  temp$text_y <- temp$seg_y + 0.1 * y_range
  
  d |> ggplot(aes(x = .data[[x_name]], y = .data[[y_name]], color = .data[[x_name]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
    paletteer::scale_color_paletteer_d("wesanderson::GrandBudapest2") +
    geom_segment(data=temp, aes(x=xstart, xend=xend, y=seg_y, yend = seg_y), linewidth=0.3, inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    geom_text(data=temp, aes(x=(xstart+xend)/2, y=text_y, label=label), size = 2, inherit.aes=FALSE, vjust=0) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}

# -- Bar plot percentage
p_colbar_vr <- function(data, mapping, ...) {

  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)
  
  x_levels <- levels(factor(data[[x_name]]))
  d <- data |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[x_name]]), !is.na(.data[[y_name]])) |> 
    mutate(!!x_name := factor(.data[[x_name]], levels = x_levels))

  d |> ggplot(aes(x = .data[[x_name]], fill = .data[[y_name]])) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(stat = "count", position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), 
              aes(label = ifelse(after_stat(count / ave(count, x, FUN = sum)) > 0.10, 
                                 scales::percent(after_stat(count / ave(count, x, FUN = sum)), accuracy = 1),"")),
              colour = "white",size = 2) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30,hjust = 1), 
          legend.position = "none",
          panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "D",
                         end = 0.8, begin = 0.2, guide = "none") 
}

# Format p-values
format_pval <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001***",
                   p < 0.01 ~ paste0("p = ", round(p, 3), "**"),
                   p < 0.05 ~ paste0("p = ", round(p, 3), "*"),
                   TRUE ~ paste0("p = ", round(p, 3)))
}

format_pval_star <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "***",
                   p < 0.01 ~ "**",
                   p < 0.05 ~ "*",
                   TRUE ~ "")
}

# -- Correlation coef
p_cor_text <- function(data, mapping, method = c("pearson", "kendall", "spearman"), ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  corr <- cor.test(data[[x_name]], data[[y_name]], use = "complete.obs", method = method)
  r <- round(corr$estimate, 2)
  sym <- if (method == "kendall") "τ" else "r"

  p_lab <- format_pval(corr$p.value)
  method_lab <- case_when(method=="pearson" ~ "Pearson",
                          method=="kendall" ~ "Kendall",
                          method=="spearman" ~ "Spearman")

  ggplot(data, mapping) +
    geom_blank() +
    annotate("text",x= mean(range(data[[x_name]], na.rm = TRUE)),
             y= mean(range(data[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)),
             label = paste0(method_lab, ":\n",sym, " = ", r, "\n", p_lab),
             size = 2.5,
             colour = "#fd6a00") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.text  = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank())
}

## pearson or kendall
p_cor_p <- function(data, mapping, ...) p_cor_text(data, mapping, method = "pearson",  ...)
p_cor_s <- function(data, mapping, ...) p_cor_text(data, mapping, method = "spearman",  ...)
p_cor_t <- function(data, mapping, ...) p_cor_text(data, mapping, method = "kendall", ...)


# -- Logistic glm (x= metric, y= vr)
p_logist_text <- function(data, mapping, site_var = NULL, ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x) 
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)
  
  df <- data |> filter(!is.na(.data[[x_name]]))

  # kendall τ between metric and visual ratings
  y_num <- as.numeric(df[[x_name]])
  kt <- cor.test(df[[y_name]], y_num, use = "complete.obs", method = "kendall")

  tau <- round(kt$estimate, 2)
  tau_p <- format_pval_star(kt$p.value)

  # glm
  df_glm <- df |>
    mutate(.fail = case_when(.data[[x_name]] == "Pass" ~ 1L,
                             .data[[x_name]] %in% c("Flag", "Fail") ~ 0L)) |>
    filter(!is.na(.fail))

  predictors <- c(y_name, "vis_qc_rater")
  if (!is.null(site_var)) predictors <- c(predictors, site_var)
  m_formula <- as.formula(paste(".fail ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))

  m<- glm(m_formula, family = "binomial", data = df_glm)
  stat_term <- summary(m)$coefficients[y_name, , drop = FALSE]
  z_val <- round(stat_term[, "z value"], 2)
  z_p <- format_pval_star(stat_term[, "Pr(>|z|)"])

  # Prepare text for plot
  label_txt <- paste0("Kendall:\n τ =", tau, tau_p, "\nGLM:\nZ = ", z_val, z_p)

  data |> 
    # filter(!is.na(.data[[y_name]])) |> 
    ggplot(mapping) +
    geom_blank() +
    annotate("text", 
             x= 0.5,
             y = 0.5,
             label = label_txt,
             size = 2.5,
             colour = "deepskyblue4") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1))
}

p_lmer_num_text <- function(data, mapping, site_var = NULL, ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x) 
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  m_formula <- as.formula(paste(y_name,"~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "), "+ (1|subject)"))

  m<- lmerTest::lmer(m_formula, data = data)
  stat_term <- summary(m)$coefficients[x_name, , drop = FALSE]
  t_val <- round(stat_term[, "t value"], 2)

  # Prepare text for plot

  ggplot(data, mapping) +
    geom_blank() +
    annotate("text", 
             x= mean(range(data[[x_name]], na.rm = TRUE)),
             y = mean(range(data[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)),
             label = label_txt,
             size = 2.5,
             colour = "#750985") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.text  = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank())
}

# -- Make router
metric_vars <- c("fd", "dice_coreg", "nmi_coreg", "dropout_score", "nmi_norm")
num_vars <- c("age")
sex <- "sex"
site <- "site"
vr_vars  <- c("vr_coreg", "vr_dropout")


make_router_lower <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  x_metric <- x_name %in% metric_vars
  x_num <- x_name %in% num_vars
  x_sex <- x_name == sex
  x_site <- x_name == site
  x_vr <- x_name %in% vr_vars
  y_metric <- y_name %in% metric_vars
  y_num <- y_name %in% num_vars
  y_sex <- y_name == sex
  y_site <- y_name == site
  y_vr <- y_name %in% vr_vars

  if (x_metric && y_metric) p_scatter_metric(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_metric && y_num) p_scatter_age(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_metric && y_sex) p_hist_num_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_num && y_sex) p_hist_num_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_num && y_site) p_hist_num_3(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_metric && y_site) p_hist_num_3(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_metric && y_vr) p_boxplot_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_num && y_vr) p_violin_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_vr && y_vr) p_colbar_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (y_site && x_sex) p_colbar_3(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_site && y_vr) p_colbar_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_sex && y_vr) p_colbar_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else ggally_blank()
}

make_router_upper <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  x_metric <- x_name %in% metric_vars
  x_num <- x_name %in% num_vars
  x_sex <- x_name == sex
  x_site <- x_name == site
  x_vr <- x_name %in% vr_vars
  y_metric <- y_name %in% metric_vars
  y_num <- y_name %in% num_vars
  y_sex <- y_name == sex
  y_site <- y_name == site
  y_vr <- y_name %in% vr_vars

  if (x_metric && y_metric)  p_cor_p(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_num && y_metric)  p_lmer_num_text(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_sex && y_metric) p_boxplot_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_sex && y_num) p_boxplot_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_site && y_metric) p_boxplot_3(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_site && y_num) p_boxplot_3(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (y_metric && x_vr) p_logist_text_site(data, mapping)  
  else if (y_site && x_vr) p_square_3(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (y_sex && x_vr) p_square_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (y_vr && x_vr) p_square(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_site && y_sex) p_colbar_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (y_num && x_vr) p_jitter_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else ggally_blank()
}


make_diag <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  nm <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  if (nm %in% num_vars) p_hist_num_1(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (nm %in% metric_vars) p_hist_num_1(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (nm == sex) p_bar_count_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (nm == site) p_bar_count_3(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (nm %in% vr_vars) p_bar_count_vr(data, mapping, ...)
}
```

```{r}
# -- Boxplot with par category 
# 2 categories 
p_boxplot_2 <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  d <- data |> 
    filter(!is.na(.data[[x_name]]))
  
  # add stats
  predictors <- c(x_name, "age")
  m_formula <- as.formula(paste(y_name,"~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "), "+ (1|subject)"))

  m<- lmerTest::lmer(m_formula, data = d)
  emm_formula <- as.formula(paste("pairwise ~", x_name))
  temp <- emmeans::emmeans(m, emm_formula)$contrast |> as.data.frame()
  t_val <- round(temp[, "t.ratio"], 2)
  t_p <- format_pval_star(temp[, "p.value"])

  label_txt <- paste0("t = ", t_val, t_p)
  
  y_max <- max(d[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(d[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  seg_y  <- y_max + 0.08 * y_range
  text_y <- y_max + 0.14 * y_range
  
  d |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[x_name]]),!is.na(.data[[y_name]])) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[x_name]], y = .data[[y_name]], color = .data[[x_name]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
    paletteer::scale_color_paletteer_d("nbapalettes::sixers_retro") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
    annotate("segment", x=1, xend=2, y=seg_y, yend=seg_y, linewidth=0.3) +
    annotate("text", x=1.5, y=text_y, label = label_txt, size=2, vjust= 0) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20)))
}

# Format p-values
format_pval <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001***",
                   p < 0.01 ~ paste0("p = ", round(p, 3), "**"),
                   p < 0.05 ~ paste0("p = ", round(p, 3), "*"),
                   TRUE ~ paste0("p = ", round(p, 3)))
}

format_pval_star <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "***",
                   p < 0.01 ~ "**",
                   p < 0.05 ~ "*",
                   TRUE ~ "")
}

# -- Correlation coef
p_cor_text <- function(data, mapping, method = c("pearson", "kendall", "spearman"), ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  corr <- cor.test(data[[x_name]], data[[y_name]], use = "complete.obs", method = method)
  r <- round(corr$estimate, 2)
  sym <- if (method == "kendall") "τ" else "r"

  p_lab <- format_pval(corr$p.value)
  method_lab <- case_when(method=="pearson" ~ "Pearson",
                          method=="kendall" ~ "Kendall",
                          method=="spearman" ~ "Spearman")

  ggplot(data, mapping) +
    geom_blank() +
    annotate("text",x= mean(range(data[[x_name]], na.rm = TRUE)),
             y= mean(range(data[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)),
             label = paste0(method_lab, ":\n",sym, " = ", r, "\n", p_lab),
             size = 2.5,
             colour = "#fd6a00") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.text  = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank())
}

## pearson or kendall
p_cor_p <- function(data, mapping, ...) p_cor_text(data, mapping, method = "pearson",  ...)
p_cor_s <- function(data, mapping, ...) p_cor_text(data, mapping, method = "spearman",  ...)
p_cor_t <- function(data, mapping, ...) p_cor_text(data, mapping, method = "kendall", ...)


# -- Logistic glm (x= metric, y= vr)
p_logist_text <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x) 
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)
  
  df <- data |> filter(!is.na(.data[[x_name]]))

  # kendall τ between metric and visual ratings
  y_num <- as.numeric(df[[x_name]])
  kt <- cor.test(df[[y_name]], y_num, use = "complete.obs", method = "kendall")

  tau <- round(kt$estimate, 2)
  tau_p <- format_pval_star(kt$p.value)

  # glm
  df_glm <- df |>
    mutate(.fail = case_when(.data[[x_name]] == "Pass" ~ 1L,
                             .data[[x_name]] %in% c("Flag", "Fail") ~ 0L)) |>
    filter(!is.na(.fail))

  predictors <- c(y_name, "vis_qc_rater")
  m_formula <- as.formula(paste(".fail ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))

  m<- glm(m_formula, family = "binomial", data = df_glm)
  stat_term <- summary(m)$coefficients[y_name, , drop = FALSE]
  z_val <- round(stat_term[, "z value"], 2)
  z_p <- format_pval_star(stat_term[, "Pr(>|z|)"])

  # Prepare text for plot
  label_txt <- paste0("Kendall:\n τ =", tau, tau_p, "\nGLM:\nZ = ", z_val, z_p)

  data |> 
    # filter(!is.na(.data[[y_name]])) |> 
    ggplot(mapping) +
    geom_blank() +
    annotate("text", 
             x= 0.5,
             y = 0.5,
             label = label_txt,
             size = 2.5,
             colour = "deepskyblue4") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1))
}

# Regression age
p_lmer_num_text <- function(data, mapping,...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x) 
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  predictors <- c(x_name, "sex")
  m_formula <- as.formula(paste(y_name,"~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "), "+ (1|subject)"))

  m<- lmerTest::lmer(m_formula, data = data)
  stat_term <- summary(m)$coefficients[x_name, , drop = FALSE]
  t_val <- round(stat_term[, "t value"], 2)
  t_p <- format_pval(stat_term[, "Pr(>|t|)"])

  # Prepare text for plot
  label_txt <- paste0("LMM:\nt = ", t_val, "\n", t_p)

  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x_name]], y = .data[[y_name]])) +
    geom_blank() +
    annotate("text", 
             x= mean(range(data[[x_name]], na.rm = TRUE)),
             y = mean(range(data[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE)),
             label = label_txt,
             size = 2.5,
             colour = "#750985") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(axis.text  = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank())
}

# -- Make router
metric_vars <- c("fd", "dice_coreg", "nmi_coreg", "dropout_score", "nmi_norm")
num_vars <- c("age")
sex <- "sex"
vr_vars  <- c("vr_coreg", "vr_dropout", "vr_distor")


make_router_lower <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  x_metric <- x_name %in% metric_vars
  x_num <- x_name %in% num_vars
  x_sex <- x_name == sex
  x_vr <- x_name %in% vr_vars
  y_metric <- y_name %in% metric_vars
  y_num <- y_name %in% num_vars
  y_sex <- y_name == sex
  y_vr <- y_name %in% vr_vars

  if (x_metric && y_metric) p_scatter_metric(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_metric && y_num) p_scatter_age(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_metric && y_sex) p_hist_num_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_num && y_sex) p_hist_num_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_metric && y_vr) p_boxplot_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_num && y_vr) p_violin_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_vr && y_vr) p_colbar_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_sex && y_vr) p_colbar_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else ggally_blank()
}

make_router_upper <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)

  x_metric <- x_name %in% metric_vars
  x_num <- x_name %in% num_vars
  x_sex <- x_name == sex
  x_vr <- x_name %in% vr_vars
  y_metric <- y_name %in% metric_vars
  y_num <- y_name %in% num_vars
  y_sex <- y_name == sex
  y_vr <- y_name %in% vr_vars

  if (x_metric && y_metric)  p_cor_p(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_num && y_metric)  p_lmer_num_text(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_sex && y_metric) p_boxplot_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (x_sex && y_num) p_boxplot_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (y_metric && x_vr) p_logist_text_nosite(data, mapping)  
  else if (y_sex && x_vr) p_square_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (y_vr && x_vr) p_square(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (y_num && x_vr) p_jitter_vr(data, mapping, ...)
  else ggally_blank()
}


make_diag <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  nm <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  if (nm %in% num_vars) p_hist_num_1(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (nm %in% metric_vars) p_hist_num_1(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (nm == sex) p_bar_count_2(data, mapping, ...)
  else if (nm %in% vr_vars) p_bar_count_vr(data, mapping, ...)
}

make_router_upper_debug <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)
  tryCatch(
    make_router_upper(data, mapping, ...),
    error = function(e) {
      message("ERROR in upper — x=", x_name, " y=", y_name, " : ", e$message)
      ggally_blank()
    }
  )
}

make_router_lower_debug <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)
  tryCatch(
    make_router_lower(data, mapping, ...),
    error = function(e) {
      message("ERROR in lower — x=", x_name, " y=", y_name, " : ", e$message)
      ggally_blank()
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
  filter(!is.na(vr), metric %in% c("nmi_norm")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=metric_value, y= vr, colour=vr)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill=vr), alpha=0.3, color=NA) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.15) +
  theme_light()  +
  paletteer::scale_colour_paletteer_d("unikn::pal_signal") +
  paletteer::scale_fill_paletteer_d("unikn::pal_signal") +
  facet_grid2(metric ~ dataset, scales = "free_x", independent = "x",
              strip=strip_themed(background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = "white", color=NULL),
                                 text_x = elem_list_text(colour = "#FD7901FF"),
                                 background_y = elem_list_rect(fill = "white"),
                                 text_y = elem_list_text(colour = "black")),
              labeller = labeller(dataset = cohort_labels, metric = metric4_labels),
              switch="y") +
  labs(x="", y="Visual QC rating") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 30), axis.title.y = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey70")) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right")
g3

ggsave(filename = "vr_metric1_n.svg", plot = g3, device = svg(), path = "poster_plots", height = 1.65, width = 2.55)
dev.off()


```


# Threshold screen

```{r}
thr_dice <- compute_thresholds_low_bad(data_rosmap$dice_coreg, percentiles = c(0.10, 0.05), sd_multiplier = c(2, 3), evt_alpha = c(0.01, 0.02))

thr_dice_labeled <- thr_dice |>
  filter(!grepl("percentile", method)) |>
  mutate(pct_flagged = sapply(threshold, function(thr) {
    round(100 * mean(data_rosmap$dice_coreg < thr, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
    }), method_label = paste0(method, " (", pct_flagged, "% flag)"))

g <- data_rosmap |>
  ggplot(aes(x = dice_coreg)) +
  geom_histogram(color = "white", bins = 80, fill = "grey35", linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_rug(alpha = 0.8, color = "deepskyblue4") +
  geom_vline(data = thr_dice_labeled,
             aes(xintercept = threshold, color = method_label),
             linetype = 1, linewidth = 0.5) +
  paletteer::scale_color_paletteer_d("Polychrome::light") +
  theme_light() +
  labs(color = NULL, x="Dice t1w-bold", y="Scan count") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size=15), axis.text = element_text(size=12))

g
```

# Example case
## Rosmap BNK
```{r}

avg_thres_rosmap <- read_csv("inputs/quality_metrics/avg_thres_rosmap.csv") 

bnk_dice <- read.csv("rosmap/onlybnk_dice_2605.csv") |> 
  rename(code=sub_ses, new_dice=dice) |> 
  left_join(data_rosmap |> select(code, dice_coreg) |> rename(old_dice=dice_coreg), by="code") |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(new_dice, old_dice), names_to= "dice") |> 
  mutate(thres_status = if_else(value > avg_thres_rosmap |> filter(metric=="dice_coreg") |> pull(avg_thresh), "Ok", "Flag")) |> 
  mutate(dice= factor(dice, levels = c("old_dice", "new_dice"), labels = c("BBR", "FLIRT")),
         thres_status= factor(thres_status, levels = c("Ok", "Flag")),
         panel="Dice t1w-bold")

dataDensity <- bnk_dice |>
  group_by(dice) |>
  do(data.frame(loc = density(.$value)$x,
                dens = density(.$value)$y)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(dens = dens / max(dens) * 0.35) |>
  mutate(dens = if_else(dice == "BBR",.9+(dens * -1), 2.1+(dens)))

g <- bnk_dice |>
  ggplot(aes(x = dice, y = value)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = thres_status), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(group = code), color = "grey80", alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_polygon(data = dataDensity, aes(x = dens, y = loc, fill = dice), alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "Dice t1w-bold", color = "Metric-based QC",
       # title = expression(underline("Example case:") ~ "1.5T BNK scans (ROSMAP)"), 
       fill="") +
  scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = dup_axis(labels = NULL)) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.title.y.left = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(size=9), legend.text = element_text(size=9),
        # title = element_text(size=9),
        # legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        # legend.position = c(0.8, 0.2), 
        legend.background = element_rect(colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#7CCA89FF", "#D01556FF"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey20", "grey20"))
g

g <- bnk_dice |>
  ggplot(aes(x = dice, y = value)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = thres_status), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(group = code), color = "grey80", alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_polygon(data = dataDensity, aes(x = dens, y = loc, fill = dice), alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "Dice t1w-bold", color = "Metric-based QC",
```
